text: In a visible message pane, threadPane._onSelect removes expanded Grouped By Sort headers before the 0/1/many message-display switch when there is at least one real message and more than one selected row. It saves and restores currentIndex. Header-row count and real message count differ, so cleanup confined to the many-message branch misses one real message plus a header. The predicate excludes collapsed groups, which remain selectable together. The changed test checks exact row arrays for collapsed/expanded selection and Ctrl+A, not the Delete action itself. Its original scalar checkSelection(0) does not match the array-valued helper; accepted0b93 uses[0] and state waits. These are source and direct-assertion observations; no test was executed.
title: Normalize expanded group headers before single-message display
